overview.description: The Northern Trust STOXX Global Broad Infrastructure ETF (NFRA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund tracks a market-cap-weighted index of global infrastructure companies from developed and emerging markets. NFRA was launched on Oct 8, 2013 and is issued by Northern Trust.
